headline: US Unemployment Falls in October Amid Strong Hiring
summary: Unemployment fell in October, extending years of stability for the U.S. workforce.
why: Employment data is a primary gauge of economic health, heavily influencing Federal Reserve monetary policy and interest rate decisions.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Strong labor market data generally supports the domestic economy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong employment growth and falling unemployment indicate continued economic resilience, which can influence interest rate expectations.
